sources.detail: Attempted and Cloudflare-blocked from this runner for the 9th consecutive day. One bounded direct GET per registered page with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + Accept-Encoding + sec-ch-ua + Sec-Fetch-* + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests + no-cache): HTTP 403 with the "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" interstitial on all six URLs (5,487-byte bodies), and one retry after a pause with a different UA and a Google referer returned the same interstitial at 1,894 B. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (http 403, dateModified null, resolved null, all six pages). No proxy, no challenge solve, no replay; r.jina.ai was not attempted. Nothing parsed, so nothing written: snapshot stays 2026-09-27 (set by the 09-27 residential local run), every page-stated published date is untouched, and no seasonVerified value changed. The stored 80 Icy Veins letters stand and keep feeding both brackets' consensus.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 162,876 B (raiding) and 169,525 B (mythic-plus) decoded. Era-verified from the ranking BODY, not the metadata: the og:description on both still reads "The War Within Season 3" (stale boilerplate) while the body reads "how each spec ranks for Raiding content in the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" and "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" — body over title/meta, the blue-tracker precedent — so seasonVerified "s2" is unchanged on both pages. The pages' own dates are Last Updated 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+), matching the stored published values and the pre-agent published-evidence receipt exactly, so published was NOT touched; only snapshot advanced to 2026-10-01. Parse: one roster-matching tierlist block per page, with the "Mythic+ Dungeon Difficulty Tier List" block rejected by ROSTER MATCH (0 of its names map) rather than by position. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 shape: raid S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6 = 40, M+ S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4 = 40, 0 unmatched rows. 0 of 80 letters moved.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,480-346,401 B decoded (no r.jina.ai — dead on /guide/* since 2026-08-03). Unescaped \/ to / across the whole document FIRST, then searched for [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] with tolerant whitespace on the [tier-label] tag; exactly one such block per page this run, so the raid-healer decoy-printHtml trap did not fire. Spec identity from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug, which sidesteps the two-word-class split. Per-page counts printed: raid 27/7/6 and M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. Every page title self-identifies Midnight Season 2 (the stray "Season 1/3/4" strings are changelog rows), so seasonVerified "s2" is unchanged. JSON-LD dateModified read off each page — raid DPS/Healer/Tank 2026-08-31, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ Healer 2026-09-10, M+ Tank 2026-09-01 — byte-identical to the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt and to the stored published values, which were therefore left alone; only snapshot advanced to 2026-10-01. 0 of 80 letters moved.

Not reachable: archon.gg is behind its Cloudflare wall for the 37th consecutive day. All eleven archon.gg routes were probed once each with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + sec-ch-ua + Sec-Fetch-*) — the six registered letter pages (raid/heroic/all-bosses and mythic-plus/10/all-dungeons/this-week, three roles each), the three ancillary raid/mythic/all-bosses pages, raid/mythic/nekzali and mythic-plus/10/altar-of-fangs/this-week. Fetched successfully, but the payload is byte-identical to stored, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Two plain curl calls to the JSON API (no headers, no proxy, no auth, never the HTML): manifest.json HTTP 200 with snapshotDate 2026-09-15, unmoved for a SEVENTH consecutive week, and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162,488 B, carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:08 GMT. Because a frozen snapshotDate is not evidence the data is frozen (the documented 2026-08-04 shape), the rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps, hps, tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined gives 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows with 0 unmatched (the melee/ranged blocks are dps subsets and were excluded by whitelist, not by blacklisting "dungeon"). Compared at the stored 1-dp precision, all 40 lowerBound values AND all 40 numberOfCharacters are identical to stored, so there was nothing to merge and asOf stays at the source's own 2026-09-15. The published letters were not ingested and must not be. The staleness red is the honest alarm here and is the owner-accepted standing state for this source.

Fetched fresh and upstream had re-simmed one more spec, so this is a verified refresh at a coverage date one day old. All 27 DPS specs requested from chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/<snake_class>/<spec>: 23 returned real payloads and 4 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on 3 attempts each (retried before concluding absence). Every one of the 23 reads simc_settings.tier = "MID2" and simc_settings.ptr = the STRING "0" (compared explicitly, never truthiness), and targets were read as data[tier][count], which is already best-build. asOf is each CHART's own timestamp, never the run date: all 23 are dated 2026-09-30 (Feral at 22:47, the other 22 at 02:57-03:02). The 12.1.5 wholesale-hold rule does not engage — PHASES.livePatch is null, LABEL_FLIP_DUE is null, and today's official notes put 12.1.5 at Oct 13 NA / Oct 14 EU, so it is not live and neither keying date applies. Merged all 23: only Druid Feral changed (asOf 2026-09-23 -> 2026-09-30, largest target move 0.05%), the other 22 byte-identical. Rogue Subtlety is NEW in the error set and keeps its stored 2026-09-23 MID2 profile rather than being dropped, so the pool is 24 profiles, 23 at 09-30 plus 1 at 09-23, all single-tier MID2 — the uniformity gate is satisfied and no partial-tier mix was published. Persistent error set is now Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Subtlety Rogue; each rejoins on the night its chart appears. Row floor 15 and the 25% row-drop gate both clear; labels are build-computed and were not hand-written.

Fetched fresh and the sim DID re-run on a new git build, so the source-owned coverage date advances. reports/MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,448,367 B, and it HAD a "DPS Ranking:" block, so the MID2_Raid.html fallback and its burst/DTPS-chart inflation trap were not needed. Era-verified off the HEADER build string, never a visible version number: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-30/69933, git build HEAD 7cbb6ef5ff, no-networking)" — live 12.1.0, no 12.1.5 anywhere. The git HEAD moved 7532b322d7 -> 7cbb6ef5ff while the build number held at 69933; that SHA is the documented freshness detector and the honest explanation for the movement. 45 ranking lines, the Raid aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with hyphens allowed to 24 DPS specs at their best hero variant, 0 unmapped names; the 7 tank profiles are correctly not ingested and the 3 DPS specs absent upstream are Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker and Devastation Evoker. All 24 values moved and every move is noise: largest Unholy Death Knight 273,395 -> 273,078 = -0.12%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6, so nothing was held back and no value_move_ack is needed. asOf = the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-30.

All four official channels swept, and the one genuinely new thing is deliberately NOT in the feed. (1) Official revision ledger, run FIRST: the pre-agent fetch-official-notes.mjs receipts (checkedAt 2026-10-01T17:09:51.506Z) show live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 still at version 51 / updatedAt 2026-09-30T00:10:48.542Z / bodySha256 2858fb54..., and ptr-preview topic 2344395 posts 1 (v3), 4 (v1), 5 (v1), 6 (v1) all at unchanged body hashes. Section diff across both sources: 0 added, 0 edited, 0 removed, with the 27 live-hotfix removed-section tombstones carried forward; 163 sections total and 0 unresolved. A deep comparison with checkedAt stripped proves the only field that changed in data/official-notes.json is each source's check time, so no disposition was manufactured and no reference was invented. node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD passes. (2) Blizzard published the CONSOLIDATED 12.1.5 Content Update Notes today at 12:00Z — forum topic 2368213 (US) / 632922 (EU), blue-tracker news 24304162, Wowhead news=383206, body read in full. 12.1.5 ships Oct 13 NA / Oct 14 EU, so the displayed live patch is still 12.1 and the pre-launch rule applies verbatim: it goes in the run report and ptr-watch/log.md, never into data/ptr-builds.json, and it does not reach the notes-only preview lane either, which reads only staff posts in topic 2344395. Its class sections (DH Devourer Collapsing Star rework, Resto Druid Nature's Bounty redesign, MM Hunter Blood Fletching replacing Unload, Prot Warrior Execute +30%, Outlaw Deft Maneuvers, Subtlety Shadow-damage pass, Disc/Holy Priest, Evoker and Shaman changes) contain NO set-bonus line, so no spec.tierSet edit was due and the upkeep gate stays quiet. OWNER ACTION STILL OPEN for a second run: LABEL_FLIP_DUE in src/normalize.mjs is still null while the Oct 13 date is now confirmed by the notes themselves. (3) Live 12.1 lane: nothing new. Wowhead RSS (40 items, 163,797 B, parsed per <item> block), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, brace-balanced off the id attribute, agreeing with the RSS top item so nothing landed mid-run) and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (50 entries) all top out at the September 29 Ula'tek hotfix, which is already feed entry 1. data/ptr-builds.json unchanged at 43 entries. Also seen and also not logged: news=383181 Kith'ix raid music (a 12.1.5 PTR datamine, and PTR material is not a feed entry while PHASES.ptr is null) and news=383204 "Rage Bug for Warriors While Dual Wielding", whose body is about the WoW: Forever beta, not Midnight. (4) The 12.1 PTR thread 2317811.json is confirmed closed: 19 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09.995Z. Dormant WCL PTR zone sweeps (52/54/56/57) were skipped as specified and their stored receipts were not touched.
